phase_1_lineage.discrepancy_explanation: V34.2 experiments were executed exclusively on the 4,000-bar dataset (BTCUSD_1h_v34_expanded.parquet). The multi-year ingestion was interrupted after 1,000 bars by Incapsula WAF rate-limiting; thus, V34.2 never consumed the 2024 multi-year file.

multi_horizon_joint_dm.method: Grant, Mrazik & Satchell (2026) Multi-Horizon Joint DM Procedure

root_causes_proven.v34_1: Log-HAR specification: log(RV_t) = beta_0 + sum beta_i log(RV_i) with exp() link function
root_causes_proven.v34_2: Linear-HAR specification: RV_t = beta_0 + sum beta_i RV_i with linear clipping

root_causes_proven.v34_1: L2 regularization penalty lambda = 0.05 added to objective

root_causes_proven.v34_2: 1,179 holdout observations (due to 528h forward target truncation)

phase_4_qlike_challenger.verdict: RECONCILED. The 0.0025 discrepancy is fully explained by Log-HAR vs Linear-HAR functional form and sample boundary truncation. Both implementations confirm an ~18% out-of-sample QLIKE reduction over OLS.

reconciliation_findings: Sample Window Discrepancy: V34.1 evaluated the full 1,943-hour window including violent volatility expansions, whereas V34.2 evaluated only a 590-hour calm sub-slice.
Serial Error Clustering: Breaches exhibit extreme autocorrelation (rho_1 = 0.88 - 0.98, rho_72 = 0.22), violating independent Bernoulli assumptions.
The Coverage Fallacy: Having 90% contained inside a wide bootstrap interval ([55.8%, 96.5%] or [86.9%, 99.7%]) reflects massive cluster variance, NOT calibrated precision.
Delayed Feedback Barrier: The 168-hour (7-day) outcome maturity creates a structural 1-week latency in adaptive conformal updating (ACI/EnbPI), causing intervals to lag behind rapid regime changes.
phase_5_c2_reconciliation.governed_status: C2_CALIBRATION_FAILED. C2 remains quarantined and UNAVAILABLE.

phase_6_htf_revalidation.friction_label: ASSUMED (70.0 bps Bitstamp round-trip taker fee + slippage allowance)

phase_7_power_analysis.governance_vs_power_distinction: 100 non-overlapping 72h governance blocks (300 calendar days) represent an operational infrastructure stability burn-in hurdle. They do NOT provide 100 trade setups. Setup frequency is ~1 trade per 571 hours, meaning effective statistical power for strategy edge is bounded by N=7.
phase_7_power_analysis.sample_size_deficit: Detecting +50 bps edge with 80% power (alpha=0.05, two-sided, SD=280.2 bps) requires N=247 independent trades (deficit = 240 trades, ~16.2 years of prospective accumulation).

phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_1_dataset_selection: CONFIRMED DISCREPANCY. V34.2 reported downloading an expanded multi-year dataset, but the experiment runner consumed the 4,000-bar dataset because the multi-year download was throttled at 1,000 bars.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_2_target_alignment: PASSED. All forward realized-variance targets use strictly causal forward sums starting at t+1.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_3_lookahead_prevention: PASSED. All parameter estimation and regime quantiles are restricted strictly to the training partition.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_4_multiple_testing: CONFIRMED. Under Holm-Bonferroni correction, zero volatility models achieve statistically significant outperformance over Standard HAR.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_5_overlapping_forecasts: CONFIRMED. Overlapping multi-step forecasts inflate naive t-statistics; Newey-West HAC bandwidth >= 2H and non-overlapping tests confirm absence of edge.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_6_c2_coverage_fallacy: CONFIRMED. Wide bootstrap intervals containing 90% reflect massive cluster uncertainty, not calibrated validity.
phase_8_adversarial_review.audit_item_7_htf_power_deficit: CONFIRMED. 7 trades provide only ~12% power; positive expectancy claims are statistically unsupported.
